data.name: MQ: Rise Above
data.detailed_description:
REACH THE HEAVENS OR BURN IN THE ABYSS

The ultimate challenge. The world is collapsing, and the only way out is up.

Welcome to the most intense and high-tech vertical survival adventure. This is not just a game—it is a monumental test of will, reflexes, and strategy. You are trapped in a collapsing reality where the sky spews destruction and the ground turns into a roaring furnace of primordial fire. Your mission is simple: Build. Survive. Transcend.

THE ART OF THE IMPOSSIBLE ASCENT

Manage chaos on the battlefield where every falling monolith is both a threat and your primary tool. Build your path to the stars in real-time, dodging dazzling lightning strikes, devastating hurricanes, and unpredictable cataclysms. When the earth turns to lava and the air turns to ice, only chosen architects of chaos will survive. Seek rare Saving Platforms—your only oases in a world that wants you dead.

FROM SURVIVOR TO DEITY

Deep and rewarding RPG systems lie at the heart of your journey. This isn't just jumping; it is full character development.

  • Infinite Progress: Gain experience with every breath and every block placed. Upgrade base stats, becoming faster, stronger, and more resilient.

  • Pantheon of Power: Master a massive library of active skills, passive perks, and game bonuses.

  • Celestial Spells: Watch the sky—there is not only danger but also spells falling from above. Catch ancient magic mid-air to turn the fury of the elements against themselves.

UNRIVALED CUSTOMIZATION: REIGN WITH STYLE

In the apocalypse, your appearance is your legacy. Thanks to thousands of combinations, no two players will ever look alike.

  • Elite Fashion: Choose from a massive wardrobe of clothes, hats, and accessories.

  • Legendary Wings and Trails: Soar with majestic wings and leave behind a dynamic trail of light, fire, or shadows.

  • Auras and Effects: Surround yourself with stunning visual effects, declaring your power to everyone around.

  • Loyal Pets: You don't have to climb alone. Equip animated pets that will follow you even into the mouth of the abyss.

CLASH WITH THE GUARDIANS OF THE SKY

The higher you climb, the fiercer the universe becomes. Enter cinematic battles with a whole pantheon of bosses. These terrifying titans use all elements to bring your tower down. Defeat them to take their power and continue the path toward the light.

ASCENSION WITH THE WORLD

Why face the end of the world alone? Enter seamless multiplayer and unite with friends or rivals.

  • Collaborate to build monuments of incredible scale.

  • Compete to prove who truly deserves the crown of the heavens.

  • Shine: Demonstrate your rare wings, pets, and trails in a living community of survivors.

The abyss is hungry. The heavens await. The choice is yours. WILL YOU BURN, OR WILL YOU LEARN TO FLY?

data.short_description: Reach the heavens or burn in the abyss! In this intense physics survival, build your path out of a crumbling world. Dodge lightning and hurricanes, defeat epic bosses, and level up your hero. With wings, pets, and multiplayer, customize your legend and conquer the ultimate ascent!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel / AMD processor, 2 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 512 MB (NVIDIA GeForce 8600 GT / AMD Radeon HD 4650 / Intel HD Graphics 3000)
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5, 3.0+ GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2 GB VRAM (GTX 750 Ti / RX 560)
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
